loadFailed: Could not load credits. Refresh the page.
emptyHint: Add a credit or an instalment plan: its instalments show up here and in Upcoming. The full purchase price never becomes an expense — only paid instalments do.

totals.summary: {credits, plural, one {# credit} other {# credits}} · {installments, plural, one {# instalment} other {# instalments}} scheduled

estimatedNote: Estimated schedule, not the bank's: the sums are split evenly. Check the last instalments and the date rules with the lender.

card.notFound: Credit not found: it may have been removed.
card.unconfirmed: Instalment {number} of {date} is not confirmed. The calendar does not confirm a payment: mark it or link an existing operation.
card.manageText: A closed credit stays in the history with its paid instalments and their operations; unpaid instalments are cancelled.

schedule.title: Instalment schedule
schedule.estimated: Estimated schedule, not the bank's: the sums are split evenly, the rounding remainder goes into the last instalment.
schedule.paidBefore: {count, plural, one {Instalment 1 was entered as paid} other {Instalments 1–# were entered as paid}} without dates — no fake operations were created.

form.name: Purchase
form.priceHint: Not an expense: only paid instalments are expenses
form.equalHint: The schedule will be estimated: equal monthly parts, the rounding remainder in the last instalment.
form.paidCountHint: Before tracking: no dates and no fake operations
form.scheduleHint: Enter the dates and sums from the bank's schedule — such a schedule counts as exact.

payoff.title: Early repayment
payoff.text: Left by the schedule: {amount} ({count, plural, one {# instalment} other {# instalments}}). One instalment for the whole sum replaces the unpaid ones; you confirm the payment in the next step.
payoff.partialHint: A partial repayment changes the schedule at the bank: Saldo does not guess it — check the new schedule with the lender.

close.title: Close the credit «{name}»?
close.text: {count, plural, =0 {No unpaid instalments.} one {# unpaid instalment will be cancelled.} other {# unpaid instalments will be cancelled.}}
close.info: Paid instalments and their operations stay in the history. A credit cannot be deleted yet — only closed.
